page.running_head: Lib. 10. De sent. secunda. & gub. aeterna

main_text.p: Secunda est in reprobos omnes, abite a me exe- De secunda sententia. cap. 5.crabiles in ignem æternum, qui paratus est Diabolo & angelis eius. Mat. 25. 41.

Atque hæc de gubernatione temporaria, quasinita, Christus cum omne imperium, & omnem potentiam, & virtutem aboleuerit, regnum tradet patri, vt non amplius vt mediator regno potitus, secundum humanitatem ipse etiam Deo subiciatur, ita tamen vt ipse sit aliis omnibus gloriæ, luminis, vitæ, totiusq; felicitatis, flos, fons, & scaturigo. 1. Cor. 15. 24. 25. 26. Apoc. 21. 9. 22. & 22. 1. 3.
Æterna est nulla seculorum successione definita; & qualis fuerit, alias quam in bonorum & malorum retributione æterna prædicta, plane retinetur. Apoc. 10. 6.

page.notes: Left margin shows cropped fragments of the facing page, not transcribed. A pointing-hand mark stands by the marginal note at the start of the second paragraph. Long s is rendered as s throughout; the final ornament after FINIS is a printer's device and is not transcribed as text.
